_comment: The Meadows palette, sampled from docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png. One source for materials, UI and lighting, so they cannot drift apart. The previous prototype tuned its sky colour and its ambient light as two separate values and they disagreed for months without anyone being able to name why.
_caveat: Sampled from a painted board, so treat these as the intended relationships rather than as final surface albedo. A colour that reads correct in concept art is usually too saturated once a real directional light multiplies it.
_reserved: tether_oxblood is the danger accent. It appears only on Team Tether banners, equipment and uniforms, never on friendly or neutral elements. A reserved colour is what lets a player read threat at distance without a marker.
_comment_accent:
TEAM TETHER'S COLOUR, spent in M13. Until now `accent` held one value and nothing in the game read it — `map_canvas.gd`, `ui_style.gd` and `release_screen.gd` each say in a comment that they are deliberately NOT using it, which is the reservation working, but a reserved colour that is never spent is just an unused key. `scripts/trainers/tether_dress.gd` is the one reader, and it is the only file allowed to be one.

FOUR VALUES, ONE ACCENT. `tether_oxblood` is unchanged and is still the definition; the other three are the same accent at the three other jobs it has to do, because one hex cannot be a banner, a machine and a live cable at once. Every one of them is under the same reservation: never on a friendly or neutral element, never in the HUD, never on the meadow.

accent._comment_oxblood: THE DEFINITION, unchanged since it was reserved. Sampled off the key art's banner in shadow. As an albedo under the meadow's 1.15-energy sun it renders near-black with a plum cast, which is right for deep folds of cloth and wrong for everything else — a whole banner at this value reads as a black rectangle at forty metres, and the accent's entire job is to be readable at distance. Hence the three below.
accent._comment_cloth: THE BANNER. The same hue driven up in value and saturation until it survives being multiplied by a directional light. The file's own `_caveat` warns that a painted-board colour is usually too saturated once a real light multiplies it; this is that caveat running the other way, and it was set by rendering a banner at the Warden's post and looking at it, not by picking a number. Bright enough to read as blood at distance, dark enough that it is never mistaken for the meadow's flower gold or the HUD's warm amber.
accent._comment_iron: THE MACHINERY. Barricades, pylons, cable drums and cage frames. Deliberately NOT oxblood: §28 asks for old stone and natural forms CONTRASTED with machinery, and a stronghold where the equipment is the same colour as the flags has no contrast in it. A cold near-black with a blue cast, which is the one value in this palette that appears nowhere in the meadow and nowhere on a building.
accent._comment_live: THE TETHER ITSELF. The cable that holds a creature, and the only thing in the game allowed to emit this colour. It is the accent pushed past cloth into something that is obviously powered rather than dyed, so a player who has learned that oxblood means Team Tether reads a glowing one as Team Tether doing something. Goes dark the moment the tether is cut.
